title: Askwell: AI chatbot for your website, trained on your pages
text:
Askwell
How it works
Features
Pricing
FAQ
Sign in
Get started

AI CUSTOMER SUPPORT CHATBOT FOR ANY WEBSITE

Your content, answering your customers.

Askwell turns your own pages and documents into a chat assistant that replies in seconds, stays on topic, and says so when it doesn’t know.

Start free
See how it works

Free plan. No card needed. Live in a few minutes.

Acme Travel

Replies in seconds

Do you arrange airport transfers?

Yes. Transfers are included with most of our packages. Tell me where you’re flying to and I’ll check for you.

From your “Packages and perks” page

Who won the football world cup?

I can only help with questions about Acme Travel and its trips. Anything about your booking I can look up?

Type your message
Add an AI chatbot to your website in minutes.

No developers, no training runs, no dashboards to learn. Three steps, and the third is automatic.

Teach it what you know

Paste text or upload a PDF, Markdown or text file. Add a line about your business so it knows what is on topic.

Paste one line on your site

Copy a single script tag into your page. A chat button appears in the corner. No build step, no server.

Visitors get real answers

They ask in their own words and get a short, friendly reply drawn from your content, in seconds.

Helpful, and never out of its depth.
Stays on topic

Ask it about the football, a poem or its own instructions and it politely steers back to your business. It greets people, handles thanks, and tells them how to reach you when they want a human.

Any language

Visitors write in theirs. Answers come back in it, even from English content.

Honest about gaps

If your content doesn’t say, it doesn’t guess. It points people to your contact details.

One line to install
<script src="https://askwell.novitasweb.works/widget.js" data-key="pk_your_key"></script>
Try it on this page.

The chat in the corner is the real Askwell widget, answering from our own pages. Ask it something a customer of yours might ask.

Open the demo chat
How does Askwell learn from my website?
How much does Pro cost?
Can it answer in other languages?
Start free. Grow when you need to.
Free

Free forever · no card required

1 project
100 messages a month per project
3 knowledge sources per project
Standard widget look
“Powered by” badge shown
Start free
Pro

per month · opens soon

5 projects
2,000 messages a month per project
25 knowledge sources per project
Your colour, position, label and animation
No “Powered by” badge
Leads captured from chats, with CSV export
Start free, upgrade soon
Coming soon

Streaming replies

Answers appear word by word instead of all at once.

Public help page

A shareable page for each project, built from your knowledge.

Live demo on the landing page

Try Askwell on a real site before you sign up.

Questions, answered.
Will it make things up?
What if someone asks something unrelated?
What can I teach it?
Which languages does it speak?
How do I add it to my website?
What does the Free plan include?
Let your content do the answering.

Set it up today, and your next visitor gets an answer instead of a contact form.
